kurals.tr: Nayandhavarkku Nalkaamai Nerndhen Pasandhaven / Panpiyaarkku Uraikko Pira
kurals.m: I who (then) consented to the absence of my loving lord, to whom can I (now) relate the fact of my having turned sallow

kurals.tr: Avardhandhaar Ennum Thakaiyaal Ivardhandhen / Menimel Oorum Pasappu
kurals.m: Sallowness, as if proud of having been caused by him, would now ride on my person

kurals.tr: Saayalum Naanum Avarkontaar Kaimmaaraa / Noyum Pasalaiyum Thandhu
kurals.m: He has taken (away) my beauty and modesty, and given me instead disease and sallowness

kurals.tr: Ulluvan Manyaan Uraippadhu Avardhiramaal / Kallam Piravo Pasappu
kurals.m: I think (of him); and what I speak about is but his excellence; still is there sallowness; and this is deceitful

kurals.tr: Uvakkaanem Kaadhalar Selvaar Ivakkaanen / Meni Pasappoor Vadhu
kurals.m: Just as my lover departed then, did not sallowness spread here on my person ?

kurals.tr: Vilakkatram Paarkkum Irulepol Konkan / Muyakkatram Paarkkum Pasappu
kurals.m: Just as darkness waits for the failing light; so does sallowness wait for the laxity of my husband's intercourse

kurals.tr: Pullik Kitandhen Putaipeyarndhen Avvalavil / Allikkol Vatre Pasappu
kurals.m: I who was in close embrace just turned aside and the moment I did so, sallowness came on me like something to be seized on

kurals.tr: Pasandhaal Ivalenpadhu Allaal Ivalaith / Thurandhaar Avarenpaar Il
kurals.m: Besides those who say "she has turned sallow" there are none who say "he has forsaken her"

kurals.tr: Pasakkaman Pattaangen Meni Nayappiththaar / Nannilaiyar Aavar Enin
kurals.m: If he is clear of guilt who has conciliated me (to his departure) let my body suffer its due and turn sallow

kurals.tr: Pasappenap Perperudhal Nandre Nayappiththaar / Nalkaamai Thootraar Enin
kurals.m: It would be good to be said of me that I have turned sallow, if friends do not reproach with unkindness him who pleased me (then)
